sql_query:
WITH order_payment_totals AS (
  SELECT op.order_id,
         SUM(op.payment_value) AS order_total_payment
  FROM order_payments op
  GROUP BY op.order_id
)
SELECT
  op.payment_type,
  ABS(SUM( (oi.price::numeric) * (op.payment_value::numeric / NULLIF(opt.order_total_payment::numeric, 0)) )) AS total_revenue
FROM order_payments op
JOIN order_payment_totals opt ON opt.order_id = op.order_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = op.order_id
GROUP BY op.payment_type
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;
